<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v1/catalogue/corpuses/{name}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns everything an admin needs to see about one corpus in a single screen: its sources, bound ontology (the PINNED version snapshot when the binding has one, otherwise the live draft), every entity's full extraction context, edges, structures, hints, attached datasets, the views that read it, and the full SerchaQL DDL that recreates it.
